description: Tata letak khusus Jauki, gaya poster oranye, putih, dan abu-abu terang. Hanya posisi dan bentuk; adegan dan teks ditentukan Muse.

J1.prompt_template: Bold campaign poster in {aspect}. The background is a flat {accent} with a soft deeper-orange gradient and one large lighter curved swoosh.
